set.body:
Why
The existing checksum matrix can miss local errors. 0.1 needs an elementwise NumPy oracle for common public ops.

Scope
- Small fixtures: empty, rank-1, rank-2 layouts, rank-3, broadcast
- Dtypes: Boolean, UInt8, UInt16, Int, Float, Double
- Ops: arithmetic where public, min/max/clip, comparisons, casts, any/all, sum/mean/min/max, keepdims
- Exact bits for bool/integral/unsigned; declared float tolerance; NaN/Inf encoded
- Wire into numpy-parity-gate.sh and helper tests

Keep the checksum operation matrix as the performance locator.
set.title: Add elementwise NumPy common-ops oracle
